resources.string: Convert positive decimal numbers to traditional Ethiopic numerals. Everything stays on your device.
Traditional Ethiopic numerals represent positive numbers and have no zero.

Ge’ez Numerals is an offline utility for converting positive decimal numbers to traditional Ethiopic numerals.

Privacy: This app does not collect, store, transmit, or share personal data. It contains no advertising, analytics, accounts, or network access. Numbers you enter remain on your device.

The conversion follows the Unicode Ethiopic numeral characters and the W3C ethiopic-numeric algorithm.
